name: Jefferson River (Twin Bridges)
blurb: Quiet brown-trout water. Slow compared with the Madison — and a lot less crowded.

sections.notes: Diversion dam just below Waterloo — rope or portage. Don't drift it blind.
sections.accessReview: The Parsons Bridge / Waterloo label needs to be resolved to one confirmed access site. A diversion near Waterloo also requires current local guidance.

sections.notes: Parrot Castle has no boat ramp and difficult river access in the official FWP record. Do not rely on it as a take-out until a suitable replacement is confirmed.
sections.accessReview: The launch label is ambiguous, and the official Parrot Castle record describes difficult river access with no boat ramp. A suitable take-out for the planned craft has not been confirmed.
